sq.q: What is the role of the Program Counter (PC) in instruction execution?
answer: The Program Counter holds the address of the next instruction to be executed. During execution, its contents are transferred to the Memory Address Register (MAR) to fetch the instruction from memory. After each fetch, the PC is incremented to point to the next instruction, ensuring sequential execution of the program.
